# Minutae

> A local-first meeting recorder and dictation app that runs on your computer and writes plain Markdown. Free, MIT-licensed, open source, no account.

## What it does

- Detects when another app opens your microphone and shows one prompt asking if you want to record. Nothing is recorded until you say so, and no bot joins your call.
- Captures your microphone (`mic.wav`) and the other participants' system audio (`system.wav`) as two separate tracks.
- Transcribes locally with `whisper.cpp` and separates speakers with `sherpa-onnx`, letting you name them.
- Writes meeting summaries, decisions, and action items as plain Markdown files (`.md` with YAML frontmatter) alongside SQLite storage on disk.
- Provides hold-to-dictate (`Option + Space` on macOS, `Ctrl + Space` on Windows and Linux) that inserts dictated text at your cursor.

## Platforms

- macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon and Intel; Core Audio process tap on macOS 14.4+, ScreenCaptureKit audio on 13.0–14.3)
- Windows 10 and 11 (x64, WebView2, WASAPI loopback)
- Linux x86_64 (WebKitGTK 4.1, PulseAudio or PipeWire Pulse layer; Linux arm64 builds from source)

## What stays on your computer and what can leave it

- Detect ("another app is using your mic"): runs on your machine.
- Record (Core Audio, WASAPI, Pulse): runs on your machine.
- Transcribe (`whisper.cpp`, `sherpa-onnx`): runs on your machine.
- Summarize (Ollama, Codex CLI, Grok CLI, or API key): your choice. This is the one step that can leave your computer. If you pick Ollama, the transcript stays local. If you pick a cloud model, the transcript is sent to that provider.

Data folders (untouched by installs, updates, or uninstalls):
- macOS: `~/Library/Minutae/`
- Windows: `%APPDATA%\Minutae\`
- Linux: `$XDG_DATA_HOME/minutae/` (default `~/.local/share/minutae/`)

## Install commands

macOS 13+ and Linux x86_64:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CinematicGenius007/minutae/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

Windows 10/11 (x64, via Scoop):

```powershell
scoop install https://github.com/CinematicGenius007/minutae/releases/latest/download/minutae.json
```

Build from source (macOS / Linux):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/CinematicGenius007/minutae && cd minutae && sh scripts/install.sh --from-source
```
